AAF.caption: Data / Behavior
AAF.name: data_behavior_settings
AAF.doc: Settings that control the starting value, user interaction, and when the SVG signature is uploaded to Bubble.

AAG.caption: Initial Signature
AAG.name: initial_signature
AAG.doc: Optional Bubble image, image URL, SVG data URL, or image data URL shown as the starting signature. It is displayed as a background image layer and new strokes are drawn on top.

AAH.caption: Enabled
AAH.name: enabled
AAH.doc: When checked, users can draw and toolbar buttons can run. When unchecked, the pad stays visible but does not accept drawing input.

AAI.caption: Commit Behavior
AAI.name: commit_behavior
AAI.doc: Controls when the SVG signature is uploaded into Bubble's image value. on_stroke_end uploads after each completed stroke. manual waits for the Save signature action or toolbar button.

AAJ.caption: Commit Delay Milliseconds
AAJ.name: commit_delay_ms
AAJ.doc: Delay after a stroke ends before auto-upload runs. Only applies when Commit Behavior is on_stroke_end.

AAK.caption: File Name Prefix
AAK.name: file_name_prefix
AAK.doc: Prefix used for uploaded SVG file names. The plugin adds a timestamp and .svg extension.

AAL.caption: SVG Output
AAL.name: output_settings
AAL.doc: Native mobile signatures are saved as SVG files. The Signature Data URL state also returns an SVG data URL.

AAM.caption: Drawing
AAM.name: drawing_settings
AAM.doc: Settings that control SVG stroke color, stroke width, smoothing, and pad background.

AAN.caption: Pen Color
AAN.name: pen_color
AAN.doc: Color used for new signature strokes.

AAO.caption: Minimum Stroke Width
AAO.name: min_width
AAO.doc: Lower stroke-width bound used to calculate the SVG stroke width.

AAP.caption: Maximum Stroke Width
AAP.name: max_width
AAP.doc: Upper stroke-width bound used to calculate the SVG stroke width.

AAQ.caption: Background Color
AAQ.name: background_color
AAQ.doc: Background fill used inside the signature SVG and visible drawing area.

AAR.caption: Minimum Point Distance
AAR.name: min_distance
AAR.doc: Minimum distance a pointer must move before another point is recorded. Higher values produce smaller, simpler SVG paths.

AAS.caption: Throttle Milliseconds
AAS.name: throttle_ms
AAS.doc: Minimum time between recorded move points while drawing. Lower values capture more detail; higher values reduce path size.

AAT.caption: UI
AAT.name: ui_settings
AAT.doc: Toolbar, labels, and button style settings for the visible signature control.

AAU.caption: Placeholder Text
AAU.name: placeholder_text
AAU.doc: Text shown centered in the pad while no initial signature or drawn strokes are present.

AAV.caption: Show Toolbar
AAV.name: show_toolbar
AAV.doc: Shows or hides the toolbar container at the bottom of the element.

AAW.caption: Show Clear Button
AAW.name: show_clear_button
AAW.doc: Shows or hides the Clear button in the toolbar.

AAX.caption: Show Undo Button
AAX.name: show_undo_button
AAX.doc: Shows or hides the Undo button in the toolbar.

AAY.caption: Show Save Button
AAY.name: show_save_button
AAY.doc: Shows or hides the Save button in the toolbar. The workflow action can still save when this is hidden.

AAZ.caption: Clear Button Label
AAZ.name: clear_button_label
AAZ.doc: Text displayed inside the Clear toolbar button.

AAa.caption: Undo Button Label
AAa.name: undo_button_label
AAa.doc: Text displayed inside the Undo toolbar button.

AAb.caption: Save Button Label
AAb.name: save_button_label
AAb.doc: Text displayed inside the Save toolbar button.

AAc.caption: Toolbar Background Color
AAc.name: toolbar_background_color
AAc.doc: Background color of the toolbar area.

AAd.caption: Button Background Color
AAd.name: button_background_color
AAd.doc: Background color used for toolbar buttons.

AAe.caption: Button Text Color
AAe.name: button_text_color
AAe.doc: Text color used inside toolbar buttons.

AAf.caption: Button Border Color
AAf.name: button_border_color
AAf.doc: Border color used around toolbar buttons.
